mentions.name: Staaash
mentions.description: Self-hosted cloud drive that runs on your own server as a Google Drive alternative. Version 2 adds a desktop app with sync and a redesigned web app after a near-complete rewrite, and is in release-candidate stage ahead of the v2 launch.
mentions.problem: v1 lacked a desktop app with sync, which v2 adds; the project exists as a self-hosted alternative to Google Drive.
mentions.audience: People who want to run their own cloud storage (Google Drive alternative) on their own server.
mentions.source_excerpt:
I've been working on a self-hosted cloud drive (like a Google Drive alternative to run on your own server), about to release v2.

v1 didn't have a desktop app with sync, so I added one. I also redesigned the whole web app (a few pages are same as old design but I might change those later)
